title: Signed power scalar comparisons and evaluations
statement: Fix ell, E and X as in [def-pur-integral-line-reduction-data], and a locally free rank-one sheaf L over the completed integral coefficient ring. There are isomorphisms b(m,n): reduction_n(L^[m]) ≅ reduction_n(L)^[m] and e(m): L^[m] tensor L^[-m] ≅ R. The b satisfy PowerFormula: multiplication by the projected coefficient at zero, identity at one, recursive positive balancing, and the dual formula phi tensor a applied to x tensor c equals projection(phi(x))*a*c. The e satisfy EvaluationFormula: multiplication at zero and the actual functional evaluation in both orders for a positive power and its dual.

proof.text: Identify the scalarTensorPower and signedLinePower constructions with the recorded coefficientTwistPower and coefficientTwistLine recursively. Convert rank one to a trivializing cover. The scalar-extension/dual local-isomorphism theorem makes every ordinary reduction of L invertible.

Transport the normalized signed comparison along the explicit comparison between the two ordinary scalar-extension presentations. Naturality of the sheafification unit identifies their pure tensors. The unit, first-power, recursive positive and dual-evaluation clauses therefore give precisely PowerFormula.

Every positive power is rank one by signedLineTensor_equivalence. Sheafify the ordinary module/dual evaluation and use its locally constructed inverse. At zero use the scalar left unitor. For a negative exponent first swap the two factors. Naturality of sheafification and the evaluation adjunction give all three displayed section formulas, including both evaluation orders.

proof_origin.place: Proof (3), the corresponding signed-line reduction/restriction steps; isolated from lem-pur-integral-line-reduction-restriction
